name: Bottled Manhattan
description: A bourbon Manhattan batched with its dilution, bottled and kept in the freezer. Nothing to stir on site: pour it straight into a glass.
history: Bartenders have bottled stirred drinks for events for years: the water a stir would add goes in up front, so the drink is right the moment it is poured.
whyItWorks: At about 28% alcohol it will not freeze, so it pours colder than you could stir it, and adding the water ahead keeps it from tasting hot.
steps: For a 750 ml bottle (8 drinks): funnel in 12 oz bourbon, 6 oz sweet vermouth, 1 tsp Angostura and 5 oz cold filtered water. Cap and shake.
Freeze overnight; it will not set. Carry it in a cooler bag.
Pour about 3 oz into a coupe and drop in a cherry.
techniqueNotes: The water is the dilution a stir with ice would add. Leave it out and the drink tastes hot and syrupy.
Rinse an empty 750 ml bottle for it, or use a swing-top; label it.

recommendedBottles.rationale: Plenty of backbone for the vermouth.
Fresh vermouth matters; it is a third of the drink.
